title: Travelers
removeDescription: They lose access to the trip and its route. They can rejoin with the invite link.
removeFailed: Couldn’t remove {name}. Check your connection and try again.
leaveDescription: You lose access to the trip. You can rejoin with the invite link.
leaveFailed: Couldn’t leave the trip. Check your connection and try again.
offline: You’re offline. Removing and leaving need a connection.
inviteHint: Share a link. Whoever opens it joins as an editor. It works for 7 days.
shareHint: Anyone with the link joins as an editor.
